messages:
maria_cs: quick heads-up — Galaxy (enterprise) goes into dedicated pool warmup TOMORROW 02:00 UTC. final ask: confirmed quota numbers, autoscale target ranges, and who will run the loadtests.

ethan_se: I can lock quota tonight. planning to request 12 GPU units reserved (p4d-ish equivalence). will confirm by EOD.

zara_ops: autoscale policy proposal: min_replicas=3, max_replicas=30, scale_step=3, cool_down=90s. want warmup ramp profile?

maria_cs: yes ramp: 0->10rps over 10m, then 10->50rps over 40m. TTL for priming cache = 12h. also: capture any model quality feedback during ramp.

devon_sre: noted. i'll schedule the soak and chaos checks. FYI I'll enable fallback routing to smaller quantized model at 95th pct latency breach.

lia_support: onboarding checklist items still open: KMS key rotation proof, audit logs enabled, and runbook link updated with contact points. I've DM'd Galaxy with a quick survey to capture feature/latency expectations.

capacity-bot: loadtest scheduled: 2026-04-18T02:00:00Z -> 2026-04-18T06:00:00Z. test plan: steady ramp + two spike bursts. artifact: https://artifacts.redwood.ai/galaxy/warmup-2026-04-18.log

ethan_se: sample load commands for the run (copy as needed):
```
./bench --target https://dedicated.redwood/g/galaxy --clients 150 --rps 50 --duration 3600
# prefix cache priming
./prime --target https://dedicated.redwood/g/galaxy --keys-file keys.txt --concurrency 20
```

zara_ops: tagging ops: @devon_sre @ethan_se @lia_support. can we add a quick canary at 02:00 for 30m then full ramp if metrics look good?

maria_cs: yes—canary required. acceptance gates:  p95 latency < 200ms, error rate < 0.5%, tokens/sec throughput within 10% of expected profile. If any gate fails, rollback plan: shift 20% traffic to hosted tier and notify Galaxy CSM.

devon_sre: i'll wire the alerts and chart dashboards. posting runbook snippet here: 
```
- canary-window: 30m
- metrics: p50/p95/p99 latency, error_rate, gpu_util, kv_cache_hit
- rollback: traffic-shift -> hosted, scale-down reserved, open-incident channel
```

lia_support: collecting post-run feedback: short survey + prompt set for quality checks. i will run it during hours 05:30-06:00 and send results.

maria_cs: perfect. one last ask — renewal risk note: Galaxy exec asked for SLA confirmation post-warmup. can we get a short summary (uptime + observed latency percentile) and a recommended SLA tier to propose?

ethan_se: will produce quick summary within 3 hours of run end.

capacity-bot: reminder: quota commit request auto-expire in 48h unless confirmed by finance.

maria_cs: thanks team — i'll consolidate into a single handoff doc and ping Galaxy. :thumbsup:
